name: Arlington Microtransit (MICRO)
note: Pilot zones (North/South) are in northwest Arlington, bounded by North Glebe Rd, Langston Blvd and the county line (arlingtontransit.com); no stated size, county shown as proxy.

name: Bay Transit Express
note: Four zones under one BT4U app/brand. Only the Gloucester zone has a stated size (~20 sq mi, per baytransit.org and the DRPT Rural Microtransit Suitability Checklist toolkit); the other three zones (West Point/King & Queen "Paper Trail", Essex/Tappahannock "Rivah Ride", New Kent) have no published size, so the same ~20 sq mi circle is used as a proxy for each, per the shared-operator/shared-program pattern (all four run on one Bay Transit/Bay Aging app). Circles are clipped to their home counties. Source: https://www.baytransit.org

name: GLTC Flex
note: Designated zone inside Lynchburg bounded by Graves Mill Rd, Old Graves Mill Rd, Enterprise Dr, Timberlake Rd, LYH airport, Jefferson Ridge Pkwy, Forest Rd, Wyndhurst (gltconline.com/flex); no stated size, city limits shown as proxy.

name: GRTC LINK
note: Six zones (Ashland, Azalea, Broad Rock, Clover Dale, Powhatan, Sandston) span Henrico, Hanover, Chesterfield, and Powhatan counties. Checked ridegrtc.com/link (ridegrtc.com/grtc-services/link-microtransit) and news coverage (vpm.org, rictoday.6amcity.com): five of the six zones are named for neighborhoods/corridors (e.g. Azalea Ave/Meadowbridge Rd, Broad Rock/Hull Street Rd) with no stated square mileage or boundary streets; only Powhatan is described as "Entire County of Powhatan." No usable size/shape data for the other five zones to build even an approximate circle -- needs a GRTC zone map or service-area PDF for a human to trace.

name: HRT OnDemand
note: Four independent zones, each within its own named independent city, with sizes confirmed via gohrt.com/services/ondemand/: Virginia Beach ~15 sq mi, Newport News ~20 sq mi, Chesapeake ~11.3 sq mi, Hampton ~5.9 sq mi. Circles centered on each city and clipped to city limits.

name: LC Transit On Demand
note: Two independent zones in Loudoun County (~5-6 sq mi and ~14 sq mi); trips cannot cross zones.

name: MetroFLX
note: Three incorporated places in Roanoke metropolitan area.

name: MicroCAT (Charlottesville Area Transit)
note: Service zones (Pantops area and Route 29 North corridor) are small subsets of Albemarle County; no published size. Service is limited to the Pantops area and Route 29 North corridor within Albemarle County, not countywide. Checked charlottesville.gov/microcat (404 at time of check), albemarle.org's "Meet MicroCAT" post, dailyprogress.com, and infocville.com coverage: all describe a zone map for the two sub-areas but none states a square-mile size or boundary streets. No usable size data to build an approximate circle -- needs the MicroCAT zone map (in-app or via CAT) for a human to trace.

name: OmniRide Connect
note: Two separate zones: Manassas Park and Dumfries/Quantico corridor in Prince William County.
